faqs.question: Is 🐰🥕 flirty?
faqs.answer: Sometimes. 🐰🥕 can read flirt-coded when the partner emojis land in the flirting register; otherwise the read is whatever the emojis suggest.

faqs.question: Is 🐰🥕 acceptable for a wedding?
faqs.answer: 🐰🥕 is fine for wedding-coded moments when the register fits. For the announcement itself prefer relationship-coded combos.

faqs.answer: Sending 🐰🥕 twice intensifies the read. The combo lands with extra weight — usually reserved for moments that genuinely earn emphasis.
